statement: >= 15 distinct organisations have a training run >= 1e26 FLOP (Epoch AI, snapshot 2027-12-31)
status_at_phase_end: Far below threshold on known data: Epoch central estimates put 4 notable models above 1e26 FLOP, from 2 organisations (both Bloc A). Count is a lower bound because several Bloc A flagship models have no compute estimate.

items.summary: Annual AI index report notes that leading Bloc A developers have stopped reporting training compute, so threshold counts drawn from public data are increasingly estimates and lower bounds.
items.detail: Stanford AI Index 2026 (uses Epoch AI data); Foundation Model Transparency Index fell to 40 from 58.

items.summary: The leading Bloc B open-weight flagship of spring 2026 was estimated by a secondary tracker at ~1e25 FLOP, an order of magnitude below the 1e26 threshold; no compute was disclosed by the developer.
items.detail: DeepSeek-V4-Pro (DeepSeek, Apr 2026; 1.6T params, 49B active), ~9.7e24 FLOP estimate per DatacentersX frontier-training-runs table (last verified Oct 2026). Release date approximate (April 2026).

items.summary: A Bloc A developer released a frontier model trained on >=100,000 latest-generation accelerators; it became the largest known training run, but the developer was already above 1e26 FLOP, so the count of distinct organisations did not change.
items.detail: OpenAI GPT-6 Astra, trained at Stargate Abilene, Texas (Bloc A). OpenAI's earlier GPT-4.5 (Feb 2025) already >1e26 per Epoch.

items.summary: Epoch AI estimated the new record run at ~9.4e26 FLOP (90% CI ~4.6e26-1.8e27). With it, Epoch's database holds 4 notable models above 1e26 FLOP from only 2 distinct organisations.
items.detail: Epoch model page GPT-6 Astra (9.4e26, Likely; revised down from ~1e27). Models >1e26: GPT-6 Astra, GPT-4.5 (OpenAI); Grok 4, Grok 3 (xAI). All Bloc A.

items.summary: Independent tally of Epoch data (models published to 28 Oct 2026): four notable models exceed 1e26 FLOP, all from Bloc A companies.
items.detail: AI Adoption, 'Largest AI Training Runs' (published 2026-10-19, updated 2026-11-04): GPT-6 Astra 9.4e26, Grok 4 5e26, GPT-4.5 3.8e26, Grok 3 3.5e26. Secondary analysis of tier-1 data.

items.summary: Many flagship models from at least three other Bloc A frontier developers have no Epoch compute estimate; trackers describe them as 'likely candidates' above 1e26, so the organisation count (2) is a floor, not a ceiling. No known run above 1e27 yet.
items.detail: DatacentersX (verified Oct 2026) and AI Wiki 'Training compute' (Oct 2026): Gemini 3 / 3.1 Pro (Google), Claude models (Anthropic), Muse Spark (Meta) undisclosed; Epoch has no estimate. Date approximate (October 2026).
